authority_limit: HTTP method/status semantics do not prove application idempotency, durable completion, business acceptance, rollback or safe retry in every domain.
bounded_implication: Idempotency concerns the intended effect of repeated identical requests; automatic retry of possibly applied non-idempotent requests requires stronger knowledge, and 202 Accepted does not mean processing completed.
title: RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics

authority_limit: RPC commitment is not provider durability, domain effect completion, consumer acceptance or end-to-end exactly-once behavior.
bounded_implication: Retries create new RPC attempts from saved call history, and receipt of response headers commits the RPC against further transport-managed retry.
title: gRPC Retry Guide

authority_limit: Compensation protocols do not provide universal atomicity, isolation, semantic reversibility, guaranteed recovery or business acceptance.
bounded_implication: Long-running activities distinguish completion and compensation state machines, retries, failed compensation/completion and manual recovery obligations.
title: MicroProfile Long Running Actions Specification

authority_limit: Kubernetes object removal does not prove deletion of external resources, replicas, backups, disclosures, keys or legally required erasure evidence.
bounded_implication: Deletion request, deletion timestamp, terminating state, finalizer cleanup and actual removal are distinct stages; HTTP 202 only acknowledges the request.
title: Kubernetes Finalizers

authority_limit: Emitting or receiving an event does not prove effect execution, causal sufficiency, exactly-once delivery, durable processing or acceptance.
bounded_implication: An event envelope describes an occurrence for transport across systems; source, event identity, time, type and data are explicit context.
title: CloudEvents Specification

authority_limit: Telemetry is observation, not authoritative proof of business effect, completeness, durability, absence of hidden work or acceptance.
bounded_implication: Spans and events record scoped observations of operation execution and status under instrumentation context.
title: OpenTelemetry Trace API

authority_limit: Kafka exactly-once processing does not extend automatically to external databases, APIs, side effects, semantic deduplication or business acceptance.
bounded_implication: Idempotent producers and transactions scope duplicate suppression and atomic visibility to defined Kafka operations and consumer isolation behavior.
title: Apache Kafka Design — Transactions

authority_limit: A committed table snapshot does not prove downstream consumption, external-system effects, data correctness, compaction completion or business acceptance.
bounded_implication: Table updates produce metadata/snapshots and commit through atomic replacement with optimistic concurrency and retry requirements.
title: Apache Iceberg Table Specification

authority_limit: Workflow durability does not make arbitrary activities idempotent, compensate external effects, prove provider completion or grant effect authority.
bounded_implication: Workflow/activity retries are policy-bounded repeated attempts whose histories and non-retryable failures must be modeled explicitly.
title: Temporal Encyclopedia — Activity Execution and Retry

authority_limit: Runtime state does not prove application readiness, completed business work, durable external effects, safe termination or acceptance.
bounded_implication: Container create, start, state, kill and delete operations occupy distinct runtime lifecycle stages with observable state.
title: OCI Runtime Specification

authority_limit: Provenance records do not prove effect truth, causality, authority, atomicity, reversal or consumer acceptance.
bounded_implication: Generation, usage, invalidation, activity start/end and influence are distinct provenance relations and temporal events.
title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology

authority_limit: Database commit boundaries do not include uncoordinated external effects, notifications, caches, files, provider APIs or business acceptance.
bounded_implication: A database transaction groups statements into an all-or-nothing database unit whose intermediate states are not visible to concurrent transactions under described semantics.
title: PostgreSQL Transaction Processing
